definitions.energy: Mean activation squared over time, spatial tokens, heads and coordinates; no normalization by total/DC energy.
definitions.spatial_identity: After per-patch temporal centering: E_full(f)=E_spatial_mean(f)+E_spatial_residual(f), with one-sided orthonormal FFT weights.
definitions.head_aggregation: Actual Q heads=16 and KV heads=8; head statistics use their actual count without duplicated KV observations.
definitions.attention: Saved probabilities were reconstructed at capture time on CPU from actual full-key Q/K/mask/scaling; this analysis validates probabilities and compares saved reference context with o_proj-input SDPA vectors.
definitions.attention_archive_scope: Full text-position K/V are not archived, and QA archives contain only last-position Q/K/V. This offline audit cannot independently reconstruct the complete attention row or its weighted context from archived Q/K/V.
definitions.last_position: Last input/prefill text position that produces the first output logits, not a generated answer token.

diagnostic_summary.interpretation: Spatial pooling removes measured temporal variation, not established task evidence. Static-content rotation changes are positional diagnostics, not memory or motion evidence.

limitations: Only original development videos; no independent confirmation, no high-dimensional probe training or layer selection.
Static input retains position, timestamp and causal-context effects; real-minus-static is not uniquely visual motion.
Spatial tokens are fixed grid locations, not object tracks; high residual energy is not task evidence.
RoPE can change time spectra while approximately preserving individual vector norms; this is not added information.
Reference attention is not exported SDPA probability or causal necessity/sufficiency; full-key context error is reported.

Full text-position K/V were not archived; this CPU audit checks saved row normalization/masks and reference-versus-SDPA context errors, but cannot independently recompute the whole attention row or weighted context from archived Q/K/V.
Endpoint-slot mass only describes first/last visual group, not a complete independently grounded evidence interval.
QA visual trajectories are absent; neutral visual spectra cannot be treated as independent question-specific representations.
Many heads/layers/conditions from one video are not independent samples; no significance or memory-success claim.
Old layer-0 selection failures remain unexplained by these passive measurements.
